message.content:
**rs7412 (APOE gene)**  
- **Minor allele frequency (MAF) in European populations:** ~5 %  
- **Major allele frequency:** ~95 %

These figures come from the gnomAD database (v2.1.1), which aggregates exome and genome sequencing data from thousands of individuals. The MAF can vary slightly among sub‑populations within Europe (e.g., Northern vs. Southern Europeans), but the overall frequency remains close to 5 %.

**Reference**  
- gnomAD Browser: [https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/variant/rs7412](https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/variant/rs7412)

If you need more detailed breakdowns by country or ancestry group, let me know!
